blocks.text: Binibining Pilipinas Katrina Anne Johnson is basking in Japanese culture as she reflects on her first week at the 2026 Miss International pageant taking place at the “Land of the Rising Sun.” The American-Filipino pharmacist from Davao marked her “weeksary” through a social media post. “It’s officially Day 7 of MISS INTERNATIONAL and what a week it has been indeed!” she said.
